extra.final_summary:
Question: average flipper_length_mm per species.

Data quality checks:
- species: no missing, no label variants, all allowed values.
- flipper_length_mm: 2 rows out of allowed range 170-235 per rules (row 9: -185, row 48: -212, both negative/impossible). No missing, no text numbers.
- No duplicate rows.

Fix applied: excluded rows 9 and 48 (approved) because they violate flipper_length_mm range rule.

Result (mean flipper_length_mm, n=65 rows used):
- Adelie: 189.71 mm (n=34 after exclusion)
- Chinstrap: 195.73 mm (n=15)
- Gentoo: 217.81 mm (n=16 after exclusion)

Caveats: Other columns have issues not affecting this question: body_mass_g has an extreme outlier (5,700,000g vs max 6500g) and sex has case variant "FEMALE" and 3 missing values, but these were not used for this aggregation.
